need.title: Community Garden Bed Wait List - Lottery Nov 2
need.details: Good Afternoon Beachwalk, If you are interested in a garden bed plot, please email Megan Heins at mheins@castlegroup.com. Our guidelines have been revised and have been attached for your review. We will be hosting a live lottery via zoom on Monday November 2nd at 1:00PM for those who are interested in a bed assignment. Please be advised that spots for the garden are limited. If you are interested please reach out to Megan no later than 9am on Monday November 2nd to add your name to the list. Thank you and have a wonderful day!
